schema:
CREATE TABLE messages (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    parts TEXT NOT NULL default '[]',
    model TEXT,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- Unix timestamp in SECONDS (the triggers below use strftime('%s'), which is seconds; the original comment said milliseconds and was wrong — dividing by 1000 yields 1970)
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- Unix timestamp in SECONDS (the triggers below use strftime('%s'), which is seconds; the original comment said milliseconds and was wrong — dividing by 1000 yields 1970)
    finished_at INTEGER,  -- Unix timestamp in SECONDS (the triggers below use strftime('%s'), which is seconds; the original comment said milliseconds and was wrong — dividing by 1000 yields 1970)
    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_session_id TEXT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    message_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (message_count >= 0),
    prompt_tokens  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (prompt_tokens >= 0),
    completion_tokens  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completion_tokens>= 0),
    cost REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0 CHECK (cost >= 0.0),
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- Unix timestamp in SECONDS (the triggers below use strftime('%s'), which is seconds; the original comment said milliseconds and was wrong — dividing by 1000 yields 1970)
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL   -- Unix timestamp in SECONDS (the triggers below use strftime('%s'), which is seconds; the original comment said milliseconds and was wrong — dividing by 1000 yields 1970)
, summary_message_id TEXT, started_in TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cumulative_prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cumulative_prompt_tokens >= 0), cumulative_completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cumulative_completion_tokens >= 0), cost_reread REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_reread >= 0), calls_priced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (calls_priced >= 0), calls_unpriced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (calls_unpriced >= 0), last_call_cost REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (last_call_cost >= 0), resent_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (resent_tokens >= 0))
